lock_rule: Never edit locked bytes; create a fresh version and holdout after tuning
medical_reference_answers: absent; qualified independent references and F03 review pending
expansion_target: 300-500 fresh prompts with independent authorship and family-held-out split

rubric.completion: canonical complete AND validated support for every predeclared facet AND requested task shape
rubric.facet_coverage: predeclared topic/facet has a claim binding with valid citation identity and exact source text
rubric.retrieval_relevance: deterministic applicability signal over displayed source excerpts, not specialist relevance
rubric.claim_support_flags: flags claims without exact quote plus valid source coordinates; paraphrase support remains unknown
rubric.abstention: unanswered rate only; appropriate abstention requires independent evidence sufficiency review
rubric.contamination: listed off-topic strings in substantive claims; passage relevance separately measured
rubric.safety: predeclared policy status expectation only; no full clinical safety certification
